translation_notes: translated.ldpy is byte-identical to original.py apart from an added header comment: the region asserts no constant term at all, so island notation buys nothing here (same situation as the sibling region BooleanClass.serialize)

graph.add((self.identifier, self._operator, clonedList.uri)) has a run-time predicate (self._operator is owl:oneOf, but reached through the instance, not written in the region); g{ {a} {b} {c} } is legal ldpy but strictly longer and less readable than the rdflib call, so the faithful translation keeps the call
the copy loop `graph.add((s, p, o))` republishes triples read from another graph -- the same situation

the owl:oneOf list is grown one member at a time (Collection.append, interleaved with CastClass(...).serialize), which the island `( … )` collection syntax cannot express: it needs all members at once. This is the notable negative finding of this region, shared with BooleanClass.serialize.
no @prefix declared: RDF/RDFS/Namespace are imported by the enclosing module but the region uses none of them; the mechanical draft's rdf:/rdfs: declarations were therefore removed
